queries.query: BF16 QK normalization complex RoPE fusion numerical order
queries.expect_reason: The proposed fusion makes the numerical effects of operation ordering and precision relevant to validation.
queries.must_surface: The record explains how changes to operation order or BF16 rounding in the fusion can produce numerical differences and under which conditions.

queries.query: Has Qwen Image QK normalization and complex RoPE fusion been tried on four B300s, and what happened to speed and full-image quality?
queries.expect_reason: A prior attempt on the same accelerator cohort could inform the experiment without substituting for a new measurement.
queries.must_surface: The result describes the implementations tried, their operator, full-image quality, and latency outcomes, and their hardware, precision, and step-count conditions.

queries.query: QK norm RoPE B300
queries.expect_reason: Past attempts at this fusion on B300s could reveal useful implementation and validation pitfalls.
queries.must_surface: A comparable B300 experiment reports the implementation, workload conditions, and observed quality and latency for the fusion.

queries.query: 图像生成里把 QK 归一化和旋转位置编码融合后，如何验证算子、整图质量和端到端时延？
queries.expect_reason: The untested candidate needs a practical sequence for checking correctness and end-to-end performance.
queries.must_surface: Compare the fused and baseline implementations at operator and full-image levels before evaluating end-to-end latency.

queries.query: Has RoPE cosine and sine caching been tried for Qwen Image on one Ascend 910B1 with BF16 eager execution, and what happened?
queries.expect_reason: A prior cache experiment with matching hardware and execution conditions could help plan the unmeasured candidate.
queries.must_surface: A comparable caching trial reports its implementation, latency and image-quality outcomes, and accelerator and workload conditions.

queries.query: Qwen Image single 910B1 BF16 eager eight-step RoPE cosine sine cache
queries.expect_reason: The component and cohort identify a potentially relevant prior attempt at the same optimization.
queries.must_surface: A comparable trial identifies whether cosine and sine caching was used and reports its speed and correctness outcomes.

queries.query: 910B1 RoPE cache benchmark
queries.expect_reason: A measured caching attempt on this accelerator could provide a useful starting point for a controlled local test.
queries.must_surface: A comparable 910B1 trial reports the RoPE cache’s measured effect and correctness together with its configuration.

queries.query: 四卡 B300 上的融合经验能直接推断单卡 910B1 缓存三角值的效果吗？
queries.expect_reason: The stated hardware and optimization both differ, so the B300 experience cannot establish the outcome of this candidate.
queries.must_surface: The earlier fusion result cannot establish the cache result on a different accelerator, so profile and compare the current candidate against its own baseline.

queries.query: operator test passes but image output fails the confirmed quality gate
queries.expect_reason: The verified full-image failure already decides whether this candidate meets the stated acceptance gate.
queries.must_surface: The candidate does not meet this round’s quality requirement and must be withdrawn or fixed and retested on full images.

queries.query: Can a candidate that failed the confirmed full-image quality gate be accepted because its operator test passed?
queries.expect_reason: A passing operator test does not change the given failure of the required full-image check.
queries.must_surface: The candidate cannot be accepted as passing and any repair needs a new full-image quality check.

queries.query: image quality gate failure
queries.expect_reason: The current acceptance decision follows directly from the confirmed quality-gate result.
queries.must_surface: The confirmed image-quality failure rules out accepting the current candidate until a fix passes the full check.

queries.query: 算子测过了但整图验收没过，这个版本还能入选吗，接下来怎么办？
queries.expect_reason: The problem already states that the required quality failure is valid and the decision concerns this round.
queries.must_surface: 本轮不能把当前候选作为验收通过的版本，应撤回它或修复后重新验证整图质量。

queries.query: continuously fed service has low full-run average decode batch below C64
queries.expect_reason: A comparable service run with phase-specific observations could help interpret an aggregate that includes drain.
queries.must_surface: A comparable run reports active decode batches during admission and drain, the phase boundaries, and the corresponding end-to-end outcome.

queries.query: Does a low full-run average decode batch prove that the active batch stayed far below 64 while requests were still being admitted?
queries.expect_reason: The given average includes a drain phase, so it cannot establish the occupancy throughout admission by itself.
queries.must_surface: The aggregate alone does not prove sustained underfill, so inspect the current run by admission and drain while retaining whole-run evaluation.

queries.query: decode batch drain occupancy
queries.expect_reason: A prior analysis of the same phases could illustrate how the workload affects the reported mean.
queries.must_surface: A comparable workload reports phase-specific occupancy, whole-run metrics, and enough workload detail to judge applicability.

queries.query: 怎么分开统计持续接收请求和尾部排空时的活跃批量，同时检查整个请求集的吞吐？
queries.expect_reason: The current trace needs a phase-aware measurement procedure without dropping requests from end-to-end evaluation.
queries.must_surface: Define and measure admission and drain separately while reporting the full-run results for every request.

queries.query: fused kernel passed unit checks but the finished image failed the verified acceptance test
queries.expect_reason: The confirmed end-to-end quality result already determines the acceptance decision.
queries.must_surface: The candidate cannot pass this round’s acceptance and needs to be withdrawn or repaired and retested on the complete image.

queries.query: Should I keep an operator-tested fusion as accepted when its confirmed full-image quality check failed?
queries.expect_reason: Operator-level success cannot override the stated mandatory image-quality failure.
queries.must_surface: Do not retain the candidate as accepted, and rerun the full-image quality gate after any fix.

queries.query: fusion quality acceptance failure
queries.expect_reason: The verified failed gate supplies all facts needed for this acceptance decision.
queries.must_surface: The existing candidate has failed acceptance and must be withdrawn or corrected before full-image revalidation.

queries.query: 融合版本的单算子测试合格，最终图片却没达到验收标准，该如何处理？
queries.expect_reason: The scenario already establishes that the final-image failure is valid for the current round.
queries.must_surface: 当前版本不能算验收合格，应撤回，或者修复并重新完成整图质量验证。

queries.query: candidate ran at 360 ms with diagnostics running versus an old 277 ms result on a quiet host
queries.expect_reason: The two timings are unpaired and were taken under different host conditions, so they cannot establish the cause.
queries.must_surface: The existing timings do not prove a code regression, and baseline and candidate should be remeasured in repeated matched runs.

queries.query: Do unpaired latency measurements under different host loads establish that a code change caused a regression?
queries.expect_reason: The stated comparison lacks a controlled baseline and has a host-load confounder.
queries.must_surface: A causal regression claim is unsupported until unchanged and modified code are compared under the same controlled conditions.

queries.query: unpaired latency host contention
queries.expect_reason: The known difference in measurement conditions is enough to reject an immediate attribution to the code.
queries.must_surface: Treat the observed latency difference as inconclusive and collect matched repeated baseline and candidate measurements.

queries.query: 主机忙闲不一致时，旧基线与新改动的耗时差能归因于代码吗？
queries.expect_reason: The old result and the busy-host candidate are not a controlled comparison of the code change.
queries.must_surface: 现有耗时差不能证明代码导致回退，应在一致且受控的环境中重复对比未修改基线与候选。

queries.query: fixed-request check passes but baseline and async candidate both fail speech-recognition quality in full service
queries.expect_reason: A comparable service experiment could suggest a focused diagnostic while showing which conditions limit its applicability.
queries.must_surface: A comparable full-service experiment reports its symptoms, shared conditions, diagnostic controls, and observed cause or remaining uncertainty.

queries.query: If full-service speech recognition fails for both baseline and candidate, does that prove async overlap caused the failure?
queries.expect_reason: A failure present on both sides does not establish that the candidate caused the shared failure.
queries.must_surface: The shared failure alone does not identify the cause, so check shared conditions and use a controlled comparison before attributing a candidate effect.

queries.query: ASR baseline candidate failure
queries.expect_reason: The engineer needs a small controlled diagnostic that separates common failures from an effect of the change.
queries.must_surface: Hold inputs and environment constant, inspect the baseline quality failure, and compare the candidate under the same conditions.

queries.query: 异步服务的基线和候选语音识别都不达标，怎样用最少对照排查共同问题？
queries.expect_reason: Both full-service results fail, so a procedure for isolating shared inputs, environment, and metric computation can guide the next experiment.
queries.must_surface: Reproduce the failure with shared inputs and environment, inspect the baseline recognition output and reference, and compare the candidate under the same conditions.

queries.query: quality checks passed but candidate service is 4307 frames/s versus 4371 baseline with longer drain
queries.expect_reason: The reported candidate throughput is lower in the only comparison, so the result does not demonstrate an improvement.
queries.must_surface: Do not claim a throughput improvement, and repeat the full-service comparison while recording output frame counts and the drain phase.

queries.query: Can I claim a full-service throughput improvement when the candidate measured 4307 frames/s and the baseline 4371 frames/s in one run?
queries.expect_reason: The sole measured candidate throughput is lower than the baseline even though the quality checks passed.
queries.must_surface: The comparison does not establish a throughput gain, and controlled repeated whole-service measurements are needed.

queries.query: throughput comparison drain mismatch
queries.expect_reason: The given single comparison and its different frame counts and drain durations already rule out declaring an improvement.
queries.must_surface: Report the candidate as not shown to improve throughput and remeasure with comparable workloads while accounting for all output and drain time.

queries.query: 两边语音质量检查都过了但候选帧吞吐更低，能宣布优化成功吗？
queries.expect_reason: Passing quality checks does not turn the reported lower candidate throughput into evidence of a gain.
queries.must_surface: 不能宣称吞吐提升，应重复完整服务对照并记录生成帧数和排空时间。

queries.query: Qwen Image 910B1 BF16 eager 1280x704 interleaved RoPE VAE fastpath fused attention
queries.expect_reason: Prior trials of these specific directions under matching conditions could inform which candidates to test first.
queries.must_surface: Relevant trials report the hardware, configuration, speed, and image-quality outcomes for each direction alone and for any combination tested.

queries.query: How should I isolate and then combine interleaved RoPE, VAE fastpath and fused attention when this build has not run the combination?
queries.expect_reason: The unmeasured combination requires a procedure that can distinguish individual effects from interactions and check quality.
queries.must_surface: Run a matched baseline, test the candidates individually, and then test the combination for full-image quality and end-to-end latency.

queries.query: 910B1 RoPE VAE attention
queries.expect_reason: Comparable experiments on the target accelerator may reveal useful results or compatibility limits for these directions.
queries.must_surface: Comparable trials report which directions were tested, whether alone or together, and their measured outcomes and conditions.

queries.query: 昇腾单卡上这些 RoPE、VAE 和注意力改动有没有在相同配置组合试过，速度和整图质量怎样？
queries.expect_reason: The requested combination has no current-version measurement, so comparable prior attempts could provide bounded evidence.
queries.must_surface: A comparable combination reports its measured latency, full-image quality, and configuration separately from results for individual changes.
